data.title: macOS Apple Color Emoji and Bitmap Glyph Rendering in Blitz

overview.why: Generic bitmap-glyph rendering lane in blitz-paint with ttf-parser extraction adapter, LRU PNG decoding cache, and Apple Color Emoji sbix support
overview.what: macOS Apple Color Emoji and Bitmap Glyph Rendering in Blitz

overview.why: Inspect ttf-parser and swash sbix extraction and placement logic, document coordinate mapping formulas and strike selection rules

content.completion_summary: Reference repositories inspected, coordinate formulas validated, and follow-up task contracts ratified by advisor

overview.why: Implement lightweight adapter creating ttf_parser::Face from font data and calling glyph_raster_image to retrieve RasterGlyphImage

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-1: Construct ttf_parser::Face from font blob and face_index to support TTC collections like Apple Color Emoji.ttc
AC-2: Declare ttf-parser as a direct dependency in blitz-paint/Cargo.toml if needed
AC-3: Safely call glyph_raster_image and return None on missing or unsupported strikes without panic
AC-4: Normalize Apple Color Emoji origin_y using bbox.y_min when raw image.y == 0

content.completion_summary: Implemented bitmap glyph extraction adapter in blitz-paint with ttf-parser and Apple Color Emoji y_min baseline normalization

overview.why: Define NormalizedRasterGlyph struct capturing image data, format, metrics, and strike scaling factors independent of ttf-parser lifetimes

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-1: NormalizedRasterGlyph holds raw png slice/bytes, origin x, y, width, height, and strike pixels_per_em
AC-2: Explicit fallback handling when glyph_raster_image returns None or unsupported formats
AC-3: Defensive no-op on width == 0 || height == 0 without panic

content.completion_summary: Defined NormalizedRasterGlyph record and graceful no-op handling for zero-sized or unsupported strikes

overview.why: Author unit and contract tests verifying sbix strike selection and PNG byte extraction against sample fonts

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-1: Fixture unit tests for strike selection and PNG byte extraction
AC-2: macOS-gated test on Apple Color Emoji.ttc proving image.y == 0 and bbox.y_min normalization

content.completion_summary: Authored comprehensive unit and contract tests verifying strike selection, PNG header, and Apple Color Emoji descender normalization on macOS

overview.why: Implement baseline-preserving screen coordinate calculation mapping glyph (x, y) + raster metrics into Kurbo Affine transform

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-1: Compute strike_scale = run_font_size / image.pixels_per_em using selected strike ppem
AC-2: Apply generic baseline mapping: dest_x = glyph.x + image.x * s, dest_y = glyph.y - (image.y + image.height) * s
AC-3: Keep Apple-specific top==0 heuristic as an optional isolated hook only if live proof shows systematic vertical offset

content.completion_summary: Implemented baseline-preserving screen coordinate calculation mapping glyph (x, y) + raster metrics into Kurbo Affine transform and bounding rect

overview.why: Implement memory-bounded LRU cache (512 entries) for decoded peniko::ImageData keyed by (font_key, glyph_id, ppem)

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-1: Cache key normalized by (font_key, face_index, glyph_id, selected_strike_ppem)
AC-2: Store peniko::ImageData and return clone preserving Blob identity for Vello GPU atlas reuse
AC-3: Dual eviction bound: 512 entries and 16MB decoded byte limit

content.completion_summary: Implemented memory-bounded (512 entries + 16MB) LRU cache for decoded peniko::ImageData preserving Blob ID for Vello GPU atlas reuse

overview.why: Author tests verifying coordinate transform invariance across scale factors (1x, 2x Retina, 3x) and subpixel positions

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-1: Validate coordinate transform invariance across scale factors (1x, 2x Retina, 3x)
AC-2: Validate subpixel position stability under arbitrary floating-point font sizes and baseline coordinates
AC-3: Verify integration between extraction, LRU caching, and placement transform on real emoji glyphs

content.completion_summary: Authored contract tests verifying scale factor invariance (1x, 2x, 3x), subpixel stability, strict monotonicity, and full pipeline integration

overview.why: Update blitz-paint/src/text.rs to detect bitmap glyphs, dispatch via scene.draw_image, and keep vector glyphs in scene.draw_glyphs

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-1: Preserve exact shaped glyph order even when partitioning between scene.draw_image and scene.draw_glyphs
AC-2: Draw bitmap glyphs via anyrender/peniko scene.draw_image with affine transform

content.completion_summary: Implemented hybrid glyph dispatch in stroke_text with draw order preservation, global image cache, and integration test suite

overview.why: Ensure text decorations (underline, strike-through), inline backgrounds, and selection rects correctly span across bitmap glyphs

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-1: Text decorations (underline, strikethrough) span across runs containing bitmap glyphs without disruption
AC-2: Inline background fills cover bitmap glyph runs
AC-3: Text selection highlight rectangles cover emoji character clusters

content.completion_summary: Validated continuous text decorations, inline backgrounds, and selection rects across runs with bitmap emoji glyphs

overview.why: Suppress FONT_EMBOLDEN transformation for bitmap emoji runs in blitz-paint to prevent distortion

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-1: Synthetic embolden offset is bypassed for bitmap glyphs drawn via scene.draw_image even when FONT_EMBOLDEN_ENABLED is active

content.completion_summary: Verified synthetic embolden offset bypass for bitmap emoji glyphs drawn via scene.draw_image

overview.why: End-to-end verification of mixed alphanumeric text and emoji rendering with exact baseline alignment

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-1: Mixed Latin text and emoji runs share an identical baseline offset and vertical alignment
AC-2: Descender of emoji sits below baseline according to font bbox metrics

content.completion_summary: Verified baseline alignment and descender placement for mixed Latin and emoji text

overview.why: Verify rendering of complex emoji sequences including ZWJ compositions, skin-tone modifiers, flags, and variation selectors

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-1: ZWJ emoji sequences (🧑‍💻, 🏳️‍🌈, 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦) extract and render via draw_image
AC-2: Skin tone modifiers and variation selectors extract and render via draw_image

content.completion_summary: Verified rendering of ZWJ sequences, skin tone modifiers, and variation selectors

overview.why: Verify crisp high-DPI (Retina) scaling and strict container clipping adherence for emoji images

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-1: Retina scaling (1x, 2x, 3x) selects matching strikes and scales transforms accurately
AC-2: Container clipping nests draw_image between push_clip_layer and pop_layer

content.completion_summary: Verified Retina high-DPI scaling across 1x/2x/3x and container overflow clipping nesting

overview.why: Merge feature branch feat/macos-color-emoji into techton/main, bump version and publish annotated git tag techton-main-v0.2.4
